On The 6th Of August, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 25733 of 2025
 Ravi Saur (Adiwasi)
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Rudra Pratap Singh Kaurav - Advocate for the applica
 Mrs. Ankita Mathur - Pp for the State.
 Shri Ghanshyam Singh- Advocate for complainant.
 Order
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023 for grant of regular bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 20.05.2025 in connection with Crime No.536/2023 registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District Shivpuri for offence under Sections 376 (2-n), 363, 506, 34 of the IPC and Section 3,4 of the POCSO Act.
3. Allegation against the present applicant/accused is that he abducted and committed rape upon the prosecutrix aged about 15 years.
Accordingly, offence has been registered.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant contended that the applicant is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:16687 2 MCRC-25733-2025 innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
He is in custody since 20.05.2025.
The prosecutrix (PW1) has been examined before the trial court and she turned hostile and did not support the case of prosecution.
The prosecutrix in her statement has stated her age to be 22 years and she shared emotional proximity on her own will.
The applicant is aged about 25 years.
He is permanent resident of distt. Shivpuri and he is not having any criminal past.
Final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
5. Per contra, learned PP for respondent/State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

7. Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, and also taking note of the fact that the prosecutrix has turned hostile and did not support the case of prosecution, investigation is almost over and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time, therefore, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:16687 3 MCRC-25733-2025 the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C./480(3) of BNSS.
9.
